spec.title: NIGHT COAST GP
spec.oneLiner: Two drivers drift through a moonlit coastal circuit, chaining turbo boosts to beat rival karts over three laps.
mechanics: Exactly two human players compete simultaneously against four rival drivers on one coastal night circuit; each stacked camera view shows the same race from that player's perspective, not a separate arena.
The race lasts three laps through ordered checkpoint gates. Accelerate with A or UP, steer with LEFT/RIGHT, brake with DOWN, and hold B while steering through a turn to charge a drift.
Release B after a charged drift to trigger a short mini-turbo; better-controlled longer drifts produce stronger boosts, rewarding precision without requiring an extra meter.
Road boost strips provide immediate speed opportunities on straights and corner exits; leaving the road slows the kart, while collisions cause a brief wobble and loss of speed.

The first human to complete the final checkpoint on lap three wins; the race closes two seconds after the first human finishes so the result cannot stall. A player who finishes after the rival still receives a clear second-place result.

Begin with a short countdown while movement and drifting are available for practice but collisions and damage are inactive; the first straight teaches acceleration, followed by an easy corner and visible boost strip.

Pacing uses an authored coastal route of straights, gentle bends, harbor corners and cliffside curves. Rivals begin cautiously, increase toward the middle lap, and ease slightly near the final section; difficulty remains bounded.

Checkpoint crossings and completed laps give one-time score bonuses, with extra points for crossing while on a turbo boost. Position, lap, drift sparks and turbo flame provide immediate feedback through the foundation HUD and effects.

The route uses beach, palms, cliffs and harbor scenery with alternating left and right curves, four ordered checkpoints and enough recovery straights to prevent a single mistake from making the race unwinnable.
spec.artDirection: 256x224 fixed 16-colour pixel art with a compact shared race presentation using the kart foundation's two simultaneous stacked camera views, each 256x105 beneath the cabinet HUD. Karts are about 18–24 pixels wide in perspective, with clearly distinct silhouettes: Player 1 cyan body with white helmet, Player 2 coral body with yellow helmet, rivals in purple, lime, blue and orange. The night coast uses a deep navy sky, moonlit teal sea, dark cliffs, palm silhouettes, harbor lights and pale road markings; active karts, drift sparks and turbo flames use the brightest palette values. Show readable driving, left/right steering, drift lean with colored tire sparks, boost flame, collision wobble and crash-spin poses. Keep the road and hazards high contrast while scenery remains subdued.

controls.b: Hold while turning to drift; release to trigger turbo

spec.lose: A player loses the race by timing out or finishing behind the other human; severe off-road driving only slows the kart and does not create an unrecoverable state.
spec.scoring: Score checkpoint and lap completion bonuses, plus a one-time precision bonus for releasing a charged drift into a turbo; no event scores more than once.
